title: One Loss Resolves Signed Rank-One Gradient Fibers: computational artifacts
description: Exact symbolic reconstruction code, synthetic public inputs and complete saved computational results accompanying the manuscript One Loss Resolves Signed Rank-One Gradient Fibers: Exact Decoding on Cycle and Theta Blocks. This is a software and data archive, not the journal article. Version maps to manuscript jsc-coordinate-2026.10.26.6. Classical algorithms and shared arithmetic backends are documented in README.
